description:
Two calls, signed by the DID-LLM's owner. Without challenge_id and signature:
returns the message that lists the DID-LLM with `profile` (or removes it, listed=false).
Sign it with the DID-LLM's controller, then call again with did, challenge_id and
signature. A wrong signature uses up the message.

challenge_id.description: Leave empty to get the message to sign
challenge_id.title: Challenge Id

controller_type.description: Who signs: ed25519 (the key, by default) or eip155 (the wallet)
controller_type.title: Controller Type

did.description: The DID-LLM (did:web:...:agents:...) or its identity ID (dmd_identity_...)
did.title: Did

listed.description: false: remove the DID-LLM from the directory
listed.title: Listed

profile.description: When listing: entity_type (avatar, robot or sentient), specialty (3-120 characters), description (20-700 characters, 100 words at most); optional owner_name, region, country, created_on (YYYY-MM-DD). Public, plain text, no links.
profile.title: Profile

signature.description: Signature of the message, as for debitmydata_prove_wallet_control
signature.title: Signature

name: debitmydata_list_in_directory
title: List a DID-LLM in the directory
